notes: Illustrative 'what does this actually buy' unit-cost conversions for the expenditure tab - NOT sourced data like every other file in this project

defence.note: Loosely anchored to reported ANZAC-class frigate replacement cost estimates (NZD ~$600m-1bn+ each depending on spec) - rounded down for a cleaner number, not a specific costed procurement.

health.note: Rough public-hospital elective-surgery cost order of magnitude, not a specific MOH costing.

education.note: Approximate all-in (salary + on-costs) figure, not tied to a specific pay-scale step.

lawAndOrder.note: Rough salary+overhead figure, not an official NZ Police costing.

transport.note: NZ motorway construction costs vary hugely by terrain/urban vs rural - this is a round midpoint guess, not a Waka Kotahi estimate.

housingCommunity.note: Rough Kainga Ora-style build cost order of magnitude, not an official per-unit figure.

coreGovernmentServices.note: Generic back-office salary+overhead guess, not tied to any specific agency.

environmentalProtection.note: Loosely in line with reported native reforestation cost-per-hectare ranges, not a specific MFE costing.

otherExpenses.note: Deliberately vague - this category itself is a small catch-all.

welfareResidual.note: Rough order-of-magnitude, not tied to any specific benefit rate.

accommodation.unit: year of Accommodation Supplement for one household
accommodation.unitPlural: years of Accommodation Supplement for one household
accommodation.note: Rough order-of-magnitude, not a real published average payment.

otherBenefits.unit: Winter Energy Payment season for one household
otherBenefits.unitPlural: Winter Energy Payment seasons for one household
otherBenefits.note: Approximates the real WEP season total for a couple/family, but this category is a bundled residual (also includes other unspecified benefits), so treat as very rough.
